create.name: Hay River Karma Thegsum Chöling
create.bio:
Hay River Karma Thegsum Chöling is a rural Tibetan Buddhist meditation centre on thirteen wooded acres near the village of Ridgeland in western Wisconsin. It was founded in 1997 as an affiliate of Karma Triyana Dharmachakra, the Karmapa's North American monastery in Woodstock, New York, and follows the Karma Kagyu lineage under the 17th Karmapa and the late Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche. Its resident teacher is Lama Tsultrim Yeshe (John Samuelson), a monk trained in the first three-year retreat held at Karme Ling who has studied with Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche since 1989. The shrine room sits in a brick workshop he built in the 1970s and converted for practice in 2000, beside his old farmhouse.

Sunday mornings bring a teaching at ten followed by a group ritual practice that rotates through White Tara, Chenrezig and Amitabha, with sitting meditation filling the other weeks; a book class meets on Tuesday evenings. Nearly everything can be joined on Zoom as well as in person, and one Sunday each month is set aside for newcomers. Lama Yeshe gives meditation instruction and private interviews by appointment, visiting lamas from the Kagyu network come to teach, and a few overnight guests can stay for events. Many of his talks are posted on his own YouTube channel.

courses.title: Membership of Hay River KTC
courses.description: General membership covers the local centre and joint membership of Karma Triyana Dharmachakra; a lower associate rate supports local activities only. Individual and family options are offered monthly or yearly.
courses.price: General Memberships are $35 per month (or $420 per year) for individuals

courses.title: Meditation instruction and interviews with Lama Yeshe
courses.description: Lama Tsultrim Yeshe meets people by appointment for meditation instruction, personal interviews and questions about Tibetan Buddhist practice. Arranged by phone or email with the centre.

free_resources.title: Sunday teaching and group practice
free_resources.description: A weekly morning teaching followed by a chanted group practice or sitting meditation, held in the shrine room and streamed on Zoom; the calendar gives each week's topic and practice.

free_resources.title: Green Tara practice text
free_resources.description: The text used for the centre's Green Tara group practice, free to download so that people can follow along in person or online.

flags: The YouTube channel is the resident lama's own (Lama Tsultrim Yeshe), linked from the centre's About page; videos come from it. The owner may prefer to keep youtube_url for a future Lama Yeshe listing instead.

Email: the visible address on every page is info.hayriverktc@gmail.com, but its mailto link points to 108yeshe108@gmail.com (Lama Yeshe's address, also shown as 108yeshe@gmail.com on the I'm New page). The visible centre address is used. No contact form (Contact page lists address and email only).

Regional: Ridgeland is a small village in Dunn County, Wisconsin (well under 5,000 people); recorded as published. The owner may prefer a nearby town (Barron or Menomonie, named on its site for lodging).

Photos: the shrine-room building (400 px) and the farmhouse on the property (1280 px), both from its About page and checked. The site-wide banner of a Buddha statue by a pond is not used: its location is not stated.
No hub links: Lama Tsultrim Yeshe is not on Spiritpedia. Possible future listings: Lama Tsultrim Yeshe (YouTube 962 subscribers).
Lama Yeshe also leads the Minneapolis/Saint Paul KTC (named on the About page); not a separate lead tonight.
